'''Casimir Everard''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was hired by the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani Noble House]] [[Barnaba]] to participate in the [[Vor-cal]] hunt shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] used four [[ASP-4 hunter droid]]s during the hunt.<ref name="LOTE" />

He was a member of [[Boss Tosk]]'s criminal syndicate.<ref name="LOTE" />
